shared_elements: schematic rendering of the human form
limbs indicated by simple linear extensions
justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures rendered schematically rather than naturalistically, and B includes small stick-like human figures with outstretched arms while A is a single massive humanoid with a large head, folded limbs and a second head-like element stacked above. Beyond the generic presence of a human form there is no shared iconography: B is a dispersed field of small linear figures, concentric circles, a boat-like arc and rows of tally-like signs, whereas A is one bulky three-dimensional composite figure with no accompanying symbols or scene.
